name: H3 Reference Video SGLang
summary: Full-BF16 MiniMax H3 Ref2VA through SGLang: one prompt, up to 9 images, 3 videos and 3 audio references, with multi-GPU parallelism and layerwise offload.

inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.default:
A cinematic scene using the people, places and style of the reference material.

Keep the identity of <Picture 1> and the look of <Picture 2>. Follow the motion and camera language of <Video 1>. Use <Audio 1> as the sound reference.

Natural movement, coherent physics, clear action, synced sound. No subtitles, no text overlays, no logos.
inputs.help: Refer to uploads by tag: <Picture 1>-<Picture 9>, <Video 1>-<Video 3>, <Audio 1>-<Audio 3>. Images come first, then videos, then standalone audio.

inputs.label: Reference images
inputs.help: Identity, outfit, product or style references, in order.

inputs.label: Use audio from all reference videos
inputs.help: All-reference switch. Off mutes every reference video; individual Audio switches are disabled but their choices are remembered. On lets each video decide.

inputs.label: Reference videos
inputs.help: Motion, camera and performance references. 2-15 s each, 15 s total. Each video has an Audio switch; the all-reference switch above must be on for any soundtrack to survive.

inputs.label: Reference audio
inputs.help: Voice, music or sound-style references. An audio reference needs at least one image or video reference.

inputs.label: Reference detail
inputs.help: Match is faster. Max keeps a 2048 px short edge for the best identity, but reference tokens can be several times slower.

inputs.label: Aspect ratio
inputs.help: Shape only. The output size below sets the pixel class; the actual width follows this ratio.

inputs.label: Output size
inputs.help: Pixel class only. 480p is faster; 768p is the open H3-Base maximum. The exact width comes from the aspect ratio above. 2K is a separate pipeline.

inputs.label: Duration (s)
inputs.help: Official MiniMax-H3 output range: 4–15 seconds. The running GPU profile still enforces its own memory admission.

inputs.label: Steps
inputs.help: Fewer steps run faster and look rougher.

test.prompt: a cat yawns on a sunny windowsill

notes: SGLang Ref2VA backend. The supervisor uses the native full-BF16 Ref2VA tree and keeps the DiT resident on a 96 GB-class GPU; smaller GPUs use layerwise DiT streaming. Set H3_PROFILE, H3_NUM_GPUS and H3_ULYSSES_DEGREE on the container. Open H3-Base outputs 768p; 2K is planned as a separate H3-Regenerate-2K-IC app.
